svg.aria-label: QR Code generator — a high-quality QR Code generator library. Animation shows a QR code assembling module by module from a short URL until complete.
svg.font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: QR Code generator
svg.desc: Dark banner for nayuki's QR-Code-generator library. On the left, a QR code on a white card builds itself block by block from an encoded URL and holds complete, then reflows. On the right, the wordmark "QR Code generator", the tagline "High-quality QR Code generator library", and the supported languages.

g.text: High-quality QR Code generator for every stack.
Java · TypeScript · Python · Rust · C · C++
